authoring: Scene roots use Opinion; self-contained Cube/Cone roots are edited directly.

ownership.palette: Fixed-scene materials defined directly in scene MatLyr; leaf variants own inline materials.
ownership.leaf assets: Inline geometry, centering and optional Color variants/materials in each entrypoint.
ownership.scene Opinion: Default persistent scene selections and working overrides; Color definitions remain in asset leaves.

limits: No animation, instancing, payloads or live data in this introductory profile; supplied Omniverse environment/render/camera baseline is retained directly in the root (CC-01).
Reserved category folders do not imply strength or mandatory layers.
Active Kit root remains writable for host metadata; source/work layers protected.
Both shapes use standalone leaf files; plain and variant entrypoints intentionally repeat simple geometry.

baseline.composition: Copied into each SceneROOT; not a sublayer or reference
baseline.resources: Installed Kit resource paths as authored in geoANDenvEXAMPLE.usda

structurePolicy.leaves: Inline geometry and optional Color materials/variants; no USD sublayers. Preview has declared external Kit resources.
structurePolicy.compositions: Scene and assembly role layers only where needed. Lofted wrappers retain payload boundaries for the loading lesson.
structurePolicy.scaffold: Full numbered category folders at example scene scope are instructional; unused folders and unreferenced layers may be removed.
structurePolicy.acceptance: Structural adaptation only; previous runtime evidence is historical. No new runtime acceptance claimed.
structurePolicy.preview: Inline Environment, Render and OmniverseKit cameras copied from geoANDenvEXAMPLE.usda; outside Asset. Preview uses installed Kit HDR/grid resources and OmniPBR, so standalone portability is not claimed.
structurePolicy.grouping: Team choice: independent files may share a directory. Essentials keeps four shape entrypoints directly in 010_ASS_USD; LayeredScene retains named packages for the assembly/payload lessons.
structurePolicy.selections: Stored in existing scene Opinion; no separate ConfigLyr needed for this minimal example.
